notes: All food items should be individually packed & served in bio-degradable packaging material with good quality disposable cutlery.
Packaging material should be food grade and FSSAI compliant.
Pre-mix Tea/Coffee/Green Tea is served with stirrer, paper cup (bone china cup with saucer in EC), paper napkin & hot water (150 ml) in flask.
Branded soup pre-mix sachet is served with stirrer, soup bowl with underliner and hot water (200 ml) in thermos flask to EC passengers.
Parathas are packed/served in aluminium foil or aluminium wrapper.
FSSAI approved, good quality raw material is used; long grain branded basmati rice is used for Kashmiri Pulao.
Separate utensils are used for veg. and non-veg. meal items.
Refreshing tissue and hand sanitizer sachet are served during breakfast, lunch, evening tea and dinner services.
The menu is served on a cyclic basis. Option of sugar free is offered with Tea/Coffee service.
